pluperfect.en: We had reserved a table, but they couldn't find the reservation.

futurePerfect.es: Para mañana, mi papá ya habrá reservado el hotel.
futurePerfect.en: By tomorrow my dad will have booked the hotel.

conditionalPerfect.es: Habría reservado antes, pero no sabía la fecha.
conditionalPerfect.en: I would have booked sooner, but I didn't know the date.

subjPresent.es: Es mejor que reserves con anticipación.
subjPresent.en: It's best if you book ahead.

subjPresent.es: Mis amigos quieren que yo reserve la cabaña.
subjPresent.en: My friends want me to book the cabin.

subjPresent.es: Ojalá que el restaurante nos reserve una mesa.
subjPresent.en: I hope the restaurant saves us a table.

subjPresent.es: Sugiero que reservemos los boletos hoy.
subjPresent.en: I suggest we book the tickets today.

subjPresent.es: Diles que reserven el salón para el sábado.
subjPresent.en: Tell them to book the hall for Saturday.

subjImperfect.es: Le pedí a mi hermano que reservara el vuelo.
subjImperfect.en: I asked my brother to book the flight.

subjPresentPerfect.en: I hope you've reserved a table.

subjPluperfect.es: Si hubiéramos reservado antes, habríamos conseguido mejor precio.
subjPluperfect.en: If we had booked earlier, we would have gotten a better price.

impAffirmative.es: Reserva la mesa para las ocho.
impAffirmative.en: Reserve the table for eight o'clock.
